mappings.verbatim_quote:
Subject to subsection (6), every telecommunication licensee to whom any code of
practice or standard of performance issued or approved under subsection (1) applies must
comply with that code of practice or standard of performance.
mappings.impact: Telecommunication licensees must comply with codes of practice or standards of performance issued or approved by the Authority regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of subscriber information, including personal data, without subscriber consent.

mappings.impact: The provision requires developers or owners of land or buildings to provide, maintain, or give access to space or facilities within or on their property for telecommunications installations at their own expense, which may include data centres used for data-using services.

mappings.impact: A telecommunication licensee must install installation, plant or system in specified space or facility within or on a land or building to provide or enhance the quality of a telecommunication service, at the direction of the Authority.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
The Minister may, after consultation with the Authority or any
telecommunication licensee, give to the Authority or licensee (as the case may be) such
directions as the Minister thinks fit as to the exercise by the Authority or that licensee of
its functions under this Act.
mappings.impact: The Minister may give directions to the Authority or a telecommunication licensee regarding the exercise of their functions under the Act, including provisions for the control of telecommunications systems and equipment, which could include requirements for local data centres or servers in specific circumstances.

mappings.verbatim_quote:
The Authority may, in the circumstances specified in subsection (1), issue all or
any of the following directions:
(a) direct the specified person, or any associate of the specified person, to
transfer or dispose of all or any part of the specified shares, specified units
or specified equity interests (as the case may be) within such time and
subject to such conditions as the Authority specifies;
mappings.impact: The Authority may require a person to transfer or dispose of shares, units, or equity interests in a designated telecommunication licensee, business trust, or trust, or relinquish effective control over them, if the person has not complied with a condition imposed when approval was granted.
